Petitioners-accused Nos.2,3,4 who are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506, 504, 114 r/w Section 149 of IPC, 1860, and Section 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Crl.P.No.7400/2022.
2.
Petitioners-accused Nos.3,7 and 8 who are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 504, 506, 354, 149 of IPC, 1860, are before this Court in Crl.P.No.7392/2022.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo stating that, the parties have amicably settled the dispute in M.C.No.633/2022, filed by the husband of the 2nd respondent herein and in the said proceedings, the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre to explore the possibility of the amicable settlement between the parties.
4.

The parties before the Mediation Centre amicably settled the dispute among themselves, and as per the terms of the settlement, the marriage of the 2nd respondent with her husband has been mutually dissolved, and the respondent No.2 has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings.

The respondent No.2-wife has also received permanent alimony of Rs.55,00,000/-
through demand draft and gold ornaments.
5. The memo is placed on record.

Though the offences alleged against the petitioners- accused herein are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves and the respondent No.2-defacto complainant having no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement arrived between them.
Hence, the continuation of the criminal proceedings will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:

ii) The Impugned proceedings in Crime No.122/2021 registered by the Kodihalli Police Station, for the offence punishable under Section 498(A), 504, 506 and 114 r/w Section 149 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending on the file of I Additional Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.) and JMFC, Kanakapura, Ramanagara District,
insofar as it relates to Petitioners-accused Nos.2,3,4 in Crl.P.No.7400/2022 is hereby quashed.
iii) The impugned proceedings in Crime No.158/2021 registered by the Kodihalli Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 504, 506, 354, 149 of IPC, pending on the file of II Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, NC:
2023:KHC:28662 Bengaluru Rural District, Bengaluru, insofar it relates to Petitioners-accused Nos.3,7 and 8, in Crl.P.No.7392/2022 is hereby quashed.
